description:
Get GWAS associations from credible sets and save to parquet file.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table credible_set — one record = one fine-mapped credible set (study locus) of one study.
Key: studyLocusId.
Arguments: study_id accepts gwas study (resolved; unknown -> error); variant_id accepts ot variant or rsid (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by pValueMantissa asc (upstream sorts every match); `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Rows with unknown position are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Fine-mapped credible sets of OT 25.09 GWAS and molecular-QTL studies; absence means no credible set.

schema.description: Pass at least one of: study_id, variant_id, chromosome, region.

study_id.description: Accepts gwas_study; resolved to one gwas_study (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

variant_id.description: Accepts ot_variant, rsid; resolved to one ot_variant (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
